priorAssessment.R1-1: resolved: settled-input.md root Confirmed roast refinements, repeated in receipt/invitation specs and ht-0lo.1.2/ht-0lo.2.2 descriptions and acceptance, states a 5,000ms safety tick, 100-candidate cap, immediate continuation, fair finite high-water snapshots protected from arriving work, and native-wake-independent progress. It bounds healthy-daemon snapshot discovery by 5,000ms + (2*ceil(N/100)+2)*Q, explicitly excludes outages/errors/unbounded overload, and assigns early >=250-candidate-per-class fake-clock tests with blocked wakes, future/due mixtures, continuing arrivals and restart. ht-0lo.1.3 separately requires historical multi-batch coverage. This supplies the previously absent progress/latency contract and test obligation; implementation evidence remains future work by design.
